# Zuhair Alwazzour

> Zuhair Alwazzour (زهير الوزّور) is a Syrian entrepreneur and the solo founder of Ostazi, a private tutoring platform serving students across Syria. He is based in Damascus.

## Facts

- Full name: Zuhair Alwazzour (also written Zoher Alwazzour; Arabic: زهير الوزّور)
- Role: Founder — Ostazi (sole founder)
- Nationality: Syrian
- Location: Damascus, Syria
- Company: Ostazi — https://ostazi-edu.com/ — a private tutoring platform connecting students with vetted private teachers, handling scheduling, payments, and progress tracking.
